description: Local Area Transportation Characteristics by Household 2009 is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Estimates of average weekday household person trips, vehicle trips, person miles traveled, and vehicle miles traveled (per day), for all Census tracts in the United States for 2009. For latest data (2017), see For methodology, see attachments. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 116 columns, among them pmiles_4mem_2veh, vmiles_3mem_1veh, vmiles_5mem_4veh, vmiles_2mem_1veh, vmiles_5mem_3veh, vmiles_5mem_1veh. The portal shows 2024-07-01 as the last data update. Attribution given: Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
